summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new white-label branding feature on the 'Report PDF' page (ARGUS NOC). Logged in via UI as admin (info@86bit.it), selected client 86BIT_Office, and validated the full branding flow: branding panel visibility, brand name save + persistence after reload, PNG logo upload + preview, PDF generation with brand/logo embedded, logo removal, and empty-brand fallback to default. All 12 checks passed. Downloaded PDF was verified with PyPDF2: 7 pages, header/footer text 'ArgusCenter QA - Report di Rete', 'Pagina N', and 1 embedded image XObject (logo, reused across pages).

issues: Non-blocking: the 'branding-panel' container is always rendered even with no client selected (shows only the hint text). Matches spec intent but the requirement wording implied the whole panel appears only after selection.
